violated_contract: Concurrent queue pullers must not all mutate the same selected control shard, including empty or blocked visits, without exclusive fenced pull ownership. Globally identical minimum-service selection concentrates Firestore transaction read sets and writes even when no job can be leased, so adding workers amplifies contention and delays durable work.
canonical_prevention: Acquire a bounded token-fenced pull claim per control shard before reading queues/jobs, verify and release it atomically in the pull transaction, keep losing selection read-only, and use worker affinity among equal-service candidates with bounded fallback. Preserve service fairness, strict priority, privacy, capacity and job-token fences. Exercise sparse and multi-shard pulls with three real emulator clients and concurrent admission.
